summary: Keep each item together with its position.
documentation: enumerate produces pairs containing a running count and the corresponding item. The count starts at zero unless start is supplied.
inputs: An iterable and an optional starting integer.
caution: enumerate is an iterator. Convert its items into the result structure your caller expects.
scenarios: Number invoice lines in a report.
Show row numbers beside validation errors.
Attach positions to an ordered task list.
title: Number the checklist
problem: Given a list of task-name strings, return a list of objects with line (starting at 1) and task. Preserve order and duplicate names.
goal: Use enumerate() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
hint: Enumerate with start=1, then build one dictionary per pair.
